messages:
avery: Async check — Prairie private rollout. Need clarity on who owns: NAT egress fallback, cert rotation + k8s secret sync, and offline registry mirroring. Tentative milestones: firewall rules by Thu, mirror VM by Thu AM, cert rotation by Fri. Ping owners.
ravi: I can own NAT fallback + route updates. ETA Wed noon. I need the transit CIDRs and the single mirror IP once ready. @nora can you confirm CIDRs?
nora: CIDRs coming in ticket PR-462 in a sec. Note: also need 443 outbound to registry-1.redwood (34.23.45.67/32) and 50000-51000 for streaming. Rule snippet: ```fw-cmd --add-rule 'allow out tcp 443 34.23.45.67/32'```
sasha: I'll take cert rotation and k8s secret sync. Blocking on HSM/KMS access — opening a support ticket now.
deploy-bot: canary image push to staging started (img: private/prairie:v2026-03-17-rc2) — 4/8 nodes updated :rocket:
avery: Quick blocker: customer is airgapped for registry (no direct pull). We need an offline bundle/mirror. Who can run the mirror and provide the VM?
jules: I can run the mirror and prepare the tarball. Need the credentials and target path. Plan: mirror VM prepped Thu AM, start sync Thu midday.
ravi: Great. Once mirror VM IP is ready we'll add a short-lived NAT rule for it. @olivia-security please confirm acceptable transfer method and checksums.
olivia-security: Prefer scp over a persistent TLS tunnel. Require file signatures + manifests (sha256sum) and short-lived creds. I'll post the checklist in PR-462.
nora: CIDRs + firewall owner noted in PR-462. Also flagged firewall approver: @marco needs to sign-off for HA NAT failover.
marco: Approved. I'll coordinate HA NAT cutover Fri 02:00 UTC. Oncall briefed.
tango-ops: oncall notified (eng-platform-oncall). Will monitor cutover window and assist with rollbacks.
avery: Summary: owners — NAT: ravi, certs: sasha, mirror: jules, security: olivia, firewall approval: marco. Milestones: firewall Thu, mirror Thu AM, certs Fri, cutover Fri 02:00 UTC. If anything slips, escalate here or call me. :thumbsup:
jules: Quick Q — do we need offline image signing on top of tarball?
olivia-security: Yes, sign images with our internal signing key. I'll hand off signing instructions and key rotation notes in the ticket.
avery: Thanks everyone — I'll update the rollout doc, add these owners to the runbook, and ping PM + customer. If you want the short checklist in-thread I can paste it here.
